title: Two functions, one name
description:
Two teams both wrote a function called `toMetres`. One converts kilometres, the other miles. Put each in its own namespace so both can exist:

- `Metric::toMetres(double km)` returns kilometres × 1000
- `Imperial::toMetres(double miles)` returns miles × 1609.344
hints: Write `namespace Metric { ... }` around the first function and `namespace Imperial { ... }` around the second. Inside each, the function is simply called `toMetres`; outside, callers write `Metric::toMetres` or `Imperial::toMetres`.
unitTests:
TEST("Metric::toMetres") { CHECK_NEAR(Metric::toMetres(2.0), 2000.0, 1e-9); CHECK_NEAR(Metric::toMetres(0.5), 500.0, 1e-9); }
TEST("Imperial::toMetres") { CHECK_NEAR(Imperial::toMetres(1.0), 1609.344, 1e-9); CHECK_NEAR(Imperial::toMetres(10.0), 16093.44, 1e-6); }

grading.unitTests:
